From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Subject: MAP draft - Data handling & compliance milestone

Samir / Maya —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discovery call, I’m attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the data handling & compliance milestones you asked us to capture. High level recap and proposed milestones below — please review and confirm owners / timelines so we can lock the plan into the deal track.

Summary of asks from call:
- HealthSys needs clarity on retention, logging/audit exports, PHI/PII handling (redaction/pseudonymization), and required attestations (SOC2/ISO/BAA).
- HealthSys legal wants a DPA and compliance matrix prior to procurement sign-off.
- Security needs to confirm SIEM integration and KMS/HSM options.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) PHI/PII scope & permitted data fields — target: 2026-03-18 — owner: HealthSys (Samir) / Redwood SME (Marissa) — dependency: HealthSys data classification list.
2) Retention policy & configuration (per-route token retention, selectable buckets) — target: 2026-03-22 — owner: HealthSys (Legal) / Redwood (Neha) — dependency: DPA & platform config review.
3) Logging & audit trails (streaming/export to SIEM, retention window, immutable audit) — target: 2026-03-22 — owner: Redwood (Neha) — dependency: network/peering & log export format.
4) Compliance artifacts & attestations (SOC2 snapshot, compliance matrix, BAA) — target: 2026-03-16 — owner: Redwood (Marissa) — dependency: internal security sign-off.
5) Final acceptance & procurement sign-off (go/no-go) — target close: 2026-03-25 — owner: HealthSys procurement + Redwood AM.

Dependencies noted: final DPA, SOC2 evidence, approved network peering/IP ranges, SIEM integration details.

Next steps proposed:
- Samir: review attached MAP draft and confirm or suggest edits by Tue 2026-03-16.
- Redwood (Marissa / Neha): gather SOC2 snapshot, compliance matrix, and log export spec by 2026-03-16.
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up on Fri 2026-03-13 to walk through any redlines.

Attachments: HealthSys-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, redwood-compliance-snapshot.pdf

Thanks —

Aditya Rao

Subject: Re: MAP draft - Data handling & compliance milestone

Aditya / team —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft — a few clarifications from our side before we lock owners/timelines: 

1) Retention: we have regulatory requirements that may force retention up to 7 years for certain PHI records. Is Redwood able to support per-stream/per-route retention config (e.g., 90 days default, up to 7 years for scoped records)? Will there be an administrative control to set retention per model/route?
2) Encryption/KMS: we need encryption at rest with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and FIPS 140-2 compatibility. Do you support external KMS or BYOK?
3) Audit logs & SIEM: we need real-time export of audit logs to our Splunk instance and immutable audit trails for administrative actions. Can Redwood stream logs (syslog/HTTPS) and provide a schema for the events?
4) PHI/PII handling: we need options for in-flight redaction or pseudonymization prior to ingestion to the model, and guarantees about not persisting raw PHI unless explicitly configured. Can you confirm default behavior?
5) Compliance artifacts: please attach SOC2 Type II report extract and BAA draft. Our legal needs the DPA in place before procurement — target for legal sign-off is 2026-03-20.

If Redwood can confirm the above and provide the artifacts, we can keep the target close on 2026-03-25. Otherwise we’ll need to extend the timeline. 

Maya — looping you for technical validation on SIEM/KMS items.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Director, Security & Compliance
HealthSys
samir@healthsys.com | (857) 555-0222

Samir / Maya —

Appreciate the detailed questions. Below are confirmations and the updated MAP actions based on your asks. I’ve attached a v2 that reflects new owners and slightly adjusted dates to align with your legal timeline.

Quick answers:
- Retention: Redwood supports per-route retention buckets. Default retention is 90 days; we can extend to multi-year retention (configurable up to 7+ years) for scoped PHI records. Admins can set retention per model/route and we’ll capture that as a configurable field in the MAP.
- KMS/BYOK: We support customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers and an HSM-backed option. We can provide FIPS-compatible key options and an architecture note for BYOK flows.
- Audit logs & SIEM: Redwood can stream audit logs to your SIEM (HTTPS/Syslog). Neha will share the event schema and a sample Splunk ingestion recipe. Logs are append-only and support immutable audit trails for admin actions.
- PHI/PII handling: By default, user content is not persisted beyond the configured retention windows; we offer pre-ingest redaction and a pseudonymization helper (SDK option) to avoid sending raw PHI. We’ll document default behavior and configuration knobs in the compliance matrix.
- Compliance artifacts: Marissa will attach the SOC2 snapshot, the compliance matrix, and a draft BAA/DPA by Mon 2026-03-16 to meet legal’s timeline.

Updated/confirmed MAP milestones (final draft v2):
- 2026-03-16: Redwood deliverables — SOC2 snapshot, compliance matrix, draft BAA/DPA (owner: Marissa Cole).
- 2026-03-18: HealthSys deliverable — PHI/PII field list and classification, confirm which records require long-term retention (owner: Samir / HealthSys).
- 2026-03-18: Redwood deliverable — log schema + SIEM ingestion guide (owner: Neha Kapoor).
- 2026-03-22: Integration review & configuration (network peering, KMS integration, retention settings) — joint owners.
- 2026-03-25: Target close / procurement sign-off.

Action items assigned here:
- Marissa (Redwood): attach SOC2 snapshot, compliance matrix, draft BAA/DPA to MAP v2 by 2026-03-16.
- Neha (Redwood): share log event schema and Splunk ingestion guide by 2026-03-18.
- Samir (HealthSys): provide PHI field list and retention classification by 2026-03-18.
- Aditya (Redwood): schedule 30-min follow-up call — proposing Fri 2026-03-13 10:00 PT; confirm availability.

Attachments: HealthSys-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (uploaded to: https://drive.google.com/healthsys/map-draft-v2)

If that all looks good I’ll update the MAP in the deal record (HubSpot) and share the DocuSign / DPA link once Marissa uploads the draft.

Thanks —
